import sympy as s
from canonical_ground_parent_singlet_20261012 import wedge_action, complementary_singlet
v=complementary_singlet(4,2); I=s.eye(6); g=s.diag(3,-1,-1,-1);g[0,1]=s.I;g[1,0]=-s.I
h=s.Matrix([[2,1,s.I,0],[1,-2,0,1],[-s.I,0,1,1],[0,1,1,-1]])
A=s.kronecker_product(wedge_action(g,2),I); common=s.kronecker_product(wedge_action(h,2),I)+s.kronecker_product(I,wedge_action(h,2));tau=s.Rational(1,3);F=s.eye(36)+tau*A;n=(v.H*v)[0]
assert common*v==s.zeros(36,1)
assert s.simplify((v.H*F*common*F*v)[0])==0
assert s.simplify((v.H*A**3*v)[0])==0
assert g*h!=h*g
a2=s.simplify((v.H*A**2*v)[0]/n);chi=s.Rational(1,64);delta=s.Rational(-3,2);D=10*chi;gain=s.simplify((D*tau**2+2*delta*a2*tau)/(1+a2*tau**2))
assert gain<0
print({'a2':str(a2),'noncommuting_common_matter_energy':str(s.simplify((v.H*F*common*F*v)[0]/n)),'active_cube':str(s.simplify((v.H*A**3*v)[0]/n)),'complete_linear_filter_energy_difference':str(gain),'scope':'EXACT_FINITE_REPRESENTATION_PLUS_DECLARED_KINETIC_METHOD_NOT_NATIVE_GROUND'})

import itertools,json,sympy as s
from canonical_ground_parent_singlet_20261012 import wedge_action,complementary_singlet
I=s.eye(6);psi=complementary_singlet(4,2)
def common(i,j):
    e=s.zeros(4);e[i,j]=1;a=wedge_action(e,2)
    return s.SparseMatrix(s.kronecker_product(a,I)+s.kronecker_product(I,a))
cycles=[(0,1,2,3),(0,1,3,2),(0,2,1,3)];Gram=s.zeros(36);one=None
for cycle in cycles:
    hops=[common(cycle[(i+1)%4],cycle[i]) for i in range(4)];B=s.zeros(36)
    for order in itertools.permutations(range(4)):
        word=s.eye(36)
        for index in order:word=hops[index]*word
        B+=word
    assert B*psi==s.zeros(36,1) and B.H*psi==s.zeros(36,1)
    g=B.H*B+B*B.H
    if one is None:one=36-g.rank()
    Gram+=g
print(json.dumps({'method_only_not_native':True,'single_cycle_joint_nullity':one,'three_distinct_cycle_joint_nullity':36-Gram.rank(),'common_SU4_singlet_dimension':1,'all_ordered_terms_per_cycle':24,'all_copy_assignments_retained':True,'joint_kernel_equals_singlet':36-Gram.rank()==1}))
